description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for JWT token issuance, including claims such as issuer, subject, audience, token validity period, and signing credentials.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration settings for JWT token issuance, including claims, token validity, and signing credentials.

methods.name: Issuer
methods.description: Optional issuer claim identifying the principal that issued the JWT.

methods.name: Subject
methods.description: Optional subject claim identifying the principal that is the subject of the JWT.

methods.name: Audience
methods.description: Optional audience claim specifying the recipients for whom the JWT is intended.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: Gets the time before which the JWT must not be accepted; defaults to current UTC time.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: Gets the issuance time of the JWT; defaults to current UTC time.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: Calculates the expiration time based on IssuedAt plus ValidFor duration.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: Function generating a unique JWT ID, defaulting to a new GUID.

methods.name: SigningCredentials
methods.description: The security credentials used to sign the JWT token.
